verdict.rationale: Fireworks documents supervised and reinforcement fine-tuning of models up to 1T+ parameters with "start training in minutes, deploy immediately," using an OpenAI-compatible SFT data format. Trained LoRA models are served on the same platform, either by live merge into the base model or by multi-LoRA dynamic loading, via a single `firectl deployment create` command. A community user's SFT run on gpt-oss-20b independently confirms that fine-tuning jobs execute on the platform. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of serving a fine-tuned model end-to-end, and explicit documentation of which base models support fine-tuning and how training datasets are uploaded.
